scope: Blank/srcdoc iframe lifecycle and runtime MessagePort clone/transfer compatibility; no JavaScript realm engine or network navigation is added.
implemented: Attribute-presence-aware blank versus srcdoc documents, including empty srcdoc and removal
Same-value srcdoc assignment replaces the materialized child
Removed or adopted iframe subtrees discard old windows and cancel queued child/descendant messages, including immediate reinsertion
Reset clears iframe cache and removal hooks until frames are used again
Standalone top-level to child messages identify the parent sender; synchronous message-handler replies identify the child sender with inherited origin
Runtime MessagePort postMessage clones data synchronously, preserves cycles/repeated references/maps/sets, and supports ArrayBuffer transfers
Runtime MessagePort transfers via window.postMessage or another port create a new receiver wrapper, detach the old wrapper, preserve queued data, and expose received ports through MessageEvent.ports
MessagePort start/onmessage queue activation, stable handler replacement, close cancellation, and live timer routing for React virtual schedulers
Primitive messages without transfers avoid clone traversal/maps/sets and remain usable without host structuredClone
remaining_limits: Iframe script execution, external/data URL navigation, sandbox security/origin isolation, resource loading and browser WindowProxy navigation identity are not implemented.

Without separate JavaScript realms, sender inference supports installed top-level calls and synchronous message-event replies; arbitrary unbound cross-window calls or later asynchronous callbacks do not provide a true browser incumbent realm.
Runtime MessagePorts are supported by window/port postMessage transfer lists; native host structuredClone does not directly recognize these custom ports.
Complex nonprimitive messages require host structuredClone; the bare-isolate fallback supports primitives only.
MessagePort error-event delivery and host worker/Node MessagePort interoperation are not implemented.
